correctness.rationale: Independently constructed the five-dimensional stage-specific companion matrices for delay schedule (1,2,3), with correct stage-wise lag assignments, and symbolically recomputed det(zI-W2W1W0)=z^2[27000z^3+(10367-28675u)z^2+(4913-7825u)z-5780u]/27000 exactly. Schur cubic inequalities reduce to u>-10773/13315, while at u=-9/10 a real eigenvalue is approximately -1.09619. Halanay inequality yields exponential decay of the continuous DDE for |u|<1, and Rouché comparison via Re(rho conj sigma)=|z-1|^4/10 confirms each frozen integer-delay method is Schur-stable. At the threshold -1 is a simple multiplier and does not decay. The claim is for one fixed grid h=1, not all switching schedules.
